text:
Anya: Quick sync — planning to unhide the 'Advanced settings' panel behind a feature flag for beta customers tomorrow. Target: internal + 5% external orgs. Thoughts on guardrails?

Matt: Sounds fine. Is the flag per-org or per-user? I'd prefer per-org so org admins control exposure. Can we stage rollout: internal -> 1% -> 5%?

Jia: I can wire the UI toggle. Need the flag key/name + variant payload for `hidden_settings_v2` and default off. Also need final UX copy for the tooltip.

Anya: Flag key: `dashboard.hidden_settings_v2`. Audience: `beta-dashboard-early` (org-level). Stages: internal (only our `redwood` org) today, 1% tomorrow, 5% after smoke tests. Rollback: immediate kill switch.

Sara: I'll add telemetry events: `dashboard.advanced_opened`, `dashboard.advanced_submit`, `dashboard.advanced_error`. Set an alert if `advanced_error_rate` increases >0.5% relative to baseline. Also track click-through by org.

Matt: From infra: ensure evaluation is server-side to avoid client caching issues and racey toggles. Also add a migration so persisted prefs are ignored when the flag is off.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy to staging started for `service-dashboard@canary` — 3 instances. Will post status when done.

Jia: One question: do we enable for Dedicated / older frontends? Some customers run frontend 2.3.x which doesn't have the iframe shim. We should exclude `frontend_version < 2.4.0`.

Anya: Good catch. Exclude `frontend_version < 2.4.0` from the audience. Also require `enterprise_opt_in` label for any enterprise orgs we don’t want in the early cohort.

Matt: I'll open a PR to add the server-side gate and unit tests. Will ping @Jia for review and @Sara to confirm telemetry hooks.

Jia: Ack — will review tomorrow morning. I'll also add a small UX note: 'Advanced settings (Beta) — These features are experimental; changes may affect account-level configuration.'

Sara: I'll create Grafana panels for `advanced_opened` and `advanced_error_rate` and a PagerDuty rule if error_rate delta > 0.5% for 5m. Also will add a short smoke eval to check successful save flows. :eyes: 

Anya: Putting a quick JSON sketch of the flag config below — please comment if anything is off.

```json
{
  "key": "dashboard.hidden_settings_v2",
  "audience": "beta-dashboard-early",
  "variants": ["off", "on"],
  "rules": [
    {"stage":"internal","match":{"org":"redwood"}},
    {"stage":"1pct","percentage":1},
    {"stage":"5pct","percentage":5},
    {"exclude":{"frontend_version":"<2.4.0"}}
  ]
}
```

Matt: LGTM. Add server-side default `off` and a kill-switch env var `KILL_DASHBOARD_ADVANCED=true` that overrides everything.

Jia: I'll add the tooltip copy + small loading placeholder (to avoid jank when flag flips).

Sara: One more ask — can we tag all telemetry with `flag_version: hidden_settings_v2` so we can compare behavior to the previous variant?

Anya: Yes, tag events with `flag_version=hidden_settings_v2`. Final checklist for rollout: 1) flag created; 2) server-side eval + kill switch; 3) UI gated + UX copy; 4) telemetry + alerts; 5) QA smoke + signoff; 6) staged rollout (internal -> 1% -> 5%); 7) rollback plan documented.

Matt: I'll take items 1,2 and 6. PR incoming. :thumbsup:

Jia: I'll take 3 and help with 5.

Sara: I'll own 4 and create the alert.

Anya: Thanks all — internal rollout kicks off today 18:00 UTC. Ping me if anything blocks. :partyparrot:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary finished — health checks green.
